title: small bathroom garbage can
text: small bathroom garbage can. Very small (short) but it works nicely for the bathroom.  I was replacing an old one that looked cool, but had a brushed nickle base - it rusted and didn't look cool or clean anymore.. so I replaced with this one.  This one is all plastic, so that means easy to clean and no rust ever.  I ordered the gray... it's a brownish dark gray in my opinion..  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful and I hope this info is helpful to you!
